permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: The permittee shall allow authorized local, state, and federal representatives, upon the presentation of credentials: to enter upon the permittee's premises ... For purposes of this condition, the time for inspection shall be deemed reasonable during regular business hours or whenever the facility is in operation.

generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: A change in the fuel shall be considered a change in the method of operation of the data processing center and may require a new or amended permit.
generatorSets.controlTechnology: turbocharged engine and aftercooler/charge air cooler
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: The engine-generator sets (Ref. Nos. EG01 	6 EG15 and EG-2-01 through EG-2-31) shall only be operated in the following modes: a. In situations that arise from sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events where the primary energy or power source is disrupted or disconnected due to conditions beyond the control of an owner or operator of a facility including: i. A failure of the electrical grid; ii. On-site disaster or equipment failure; or iii. Public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather conditions. b. For participation in an ISO-declared emergency ... c. For periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
generatorSets.observationFrequency: Observed by the owner with a frequency of not less than once each day the engine-generator set is operated.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: equipmentFacilityID populated from 'Location' column in equipment table (CTP-02). Combined fuel throughput limit (232,500 gal/yr) applies to the group EG-2-01 through EG-2-31.
